from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's total shareholders' equity from one Form 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The total stockholders' equity amount as reported in the balance sheet")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    source_description: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of where the figure came from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[CompanyEquityRecord]
